gates.claim: the PRIVATE arm re-reads the whole weight set per tile

gates.invalidates: the apparatus. Below the floor, weight bytes are MISSING, which is impossible for an arm whose every tile reads its own copy: the counter, the attribution or the relabelling is broken (V9 should agree). Above 1.5 n is a per-call or double-count error
lines: PRIVATE's excess over n is activation re-read, and a full thrash adds at most 0.4972 of W_w1, 0.4844 of W_w2 per tread ((BM/BN)(1 - 1/num_pid_n)), inside the ceiling: V5 cannot tell a thrash from a sound page, and C6 reads it

gates.claim: the arms request the same L2 read sectors
gates.measured: 20 comparisons held; nearest its tolerance 0.9590% of 1.3% at n=2 w2 (NATIVE against SHARED)
gates.threshold: max/min - 1 <= 0.5% over the three arms at every (n, GEMM) on a card that counts every load; on one that coalesces L2 reads (compute capability 9.0 and up) SHARED against PRIVATE at n=1 within 0.5%, and NATIVE against SHARED where their live pids agree within 1.3% at every tread
gates.invalidates: the arms' identity: they issue identical loads (one kernel binary per GEMM; the dead CTAs the wider 72-slot declaration adds each load one expert id and exit), so where the count sees every load, or two arms issue the same tiles in the same order, a difference in requests is a different call
lines: compute capability 9.0, at or above Hopper's 9.0: an L2 Request Coalescer can merge reads of one sector before the L2 counts them, most likely what put this count below the loads on the GH200 and the H100 (no counter on this page sits before it), so V6 holds two pairs: SHARED against PRIVATE at n=1, one call (both route every tile to copy 0), within 0.5%, and NATIVE against SHARED where NATIVE's grid gives every live tile SHARED's pid, the same tiles under another declaration, within 1.3% at every tread
not held: PRIVATE at n >= 2 (its tiles read their own copies); their loads there rest on V5, V7 and V9 until a page carries a load count taken before the coalescer (docs/COUNTERS.md 6.8)
not gated: over the three arms at every tread the widest gap is 28.5833% at n=2 w2

gates.claim: SHARED's w2 weight reads never exceed the group model's count
gates.threshold: q_S,w2(n) <= 1.05 x group_reads at every n, scored on both edges of SHARED's weight-only bracket, its lowest call (NATIVE pooled) less e to its highest, e PRIVATE's excess over n; UNKNOWN where the edges disagree
gates.invalidates: the model's ceiling: co-residency can only remove WEIGHT reads, never add them. An activation re-read is not a weight read, and q_S counts one as if it were: at G >= E n every live M-tile is in one group, every column pass walks them all, and where that pass outgrows the L2 the A repeats reach DRAM (up to (BM/BN)(1 - 1/num_pid_n) of W_w2 per tread). The lower edge takes them out, so only a FAIL on both edges refutes the model
lines: w2 column passes not held by this card's 60 MiB L2: SHARED at n=none, PRIVATE at n=none (r3_exposure; a floor on the reuse distance, so a cell not named is not thereby safe)
